_comment: v3 — augments v2 (106 items, unchanged pricing/mapping decisions preserved) with two fixes: (1) requiresSpecialCare is now an orthogonal boolean flag on any item, not a folded-in service type — client confirmed 'special care' means special handling for ANY garment, not a distinct pricing tier; (2) reintroduces the client's FIRST price chart as a standalone 'Iron Only' tier (serviceType: ironing, no wash component) — this closes a real gap where no standalone iron-only price existed. See CLAUDE.md 'Iron-only tier reintroduced' section for what still needs client confirmation (which sub-sections of the first chart are actually meant to be iron-only vs the whole thing).

businessInfo._laundryMinimumNote: Client's rate card states 'Minimum 5 Kg applicable for laundry services' for the per-KG tier (Wash & Fold / Wash & Steam Iron / Premium Laundry). This is an ORDER-level minimum charge rule, not per-item — an order containing per-KG items should be charged for at least 5kg total even if actual weight is less.
businessInfo.freeBagPolicyWording: FREE LAUNDRY BAG FOR EVERY CUSTOMER
businessInfo._freeBagNote: New rate card says 'every customer' — earlier confirmed business rule was 'first bag free for every NEW customer' plus a ₹350 lost/damaged replacement fee. Worth confirming with client whether this is a wording simplification or an actual policy change (bag given every order vs just once per customer).
businessInfo.captionSwapNote: Client's rate card appears to have the footer captions swapped between sections: the Women's Wear section's caption reads 'And many more men's dresses & winter wear', while the Men's Wear (Dry Cleaning) section's caption reads 'And many more women's dresses & ethnic wear'. Transcribed faithfully, not corrected — flag to client.
